'''602 BBY''' or '''602<ref name="TEGtW" /> Before the Battle of Yavin''' was a [[Standard year/Legends|year]] in the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]]<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> that was a part of the era known as the [[Great Peace of the Republic]].<ref name="Era" /> The [[Utor Shock]], a conflict in which the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Judicial Forces/Legends|Judicial Forces]] had a key role in, took place in 602 BBY.<ref name="TEGtW" />

==Behind the scenes==
602 BBY was mentioned in [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]'s ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', written in [[2012]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
